currencies.directions: Right click this item then left click a socketed item to apply it. The item's quality increases the chances of obtaining more links.

currencies.directions: Right click this item then left click a magic, rare or unique item to apply it.

currencies.directions: Right click this item then left click another item to apply it.

currencies.name: Sacred Orb

currencies.directions: Right click this item then left click an armour to apply it.

currencies.name: Scroll Fragment
currencies.directions: A stack of 5 fragments becomes a Scroll of Wisdom.

currencies.name: Transmutation Shard
currencies.directions: A stack of 20 shards becomes an Orb of Transmutation.

currencies.name: Alteration Shard
currencies.directions: A stack of 20 shards becomes an Orb of Alteration.

currencies.name: Alchemy Shard
currencies.directions: A stack of 20 shards becomes an Orb of Alchemy.

currencies.name: Eternal Orb
currencies.description:
Creates an imprint of an item for later restoration
The imprint can't be applied to Fractured Items
currencies.directions: Right click this item then left click on an item to create an imprint. This imprint can later be used to restore this specific item to that imprinted state.

currencies.name: Imprint
currencies.description:
Restores an imprinted item onto the original
Can't be applied to Fractured Items
currencies.directions: Right click this item then left click on the imprinted original item to restore its modifiers. An imprint cannot be dropped or traded to other players.

currencies.name: Vaal Orb
currencies.description: Corrupts an item, modifying it unpredictably
currencies.directions: Right click this item then left click an item to corrupt it. Corrupted items cannot be modified again.

currencies.name: Enchant
currencies.description: Adds an enchantment to an item, or replaces an existing enchantment
currencies.directions: Left click on the skull and then left click on the item you wish to modify.

currencies.name: Tainted Blessing
currencies.directions: Can be placed in the Divine Font to allow enchantment of corrupted gloves, boots, helmets or belts.

currencies.name: Perandus Coin
currencies.directions: Trade coins to Cadiro Perandus.

currencies.name: Silver Coin
currencies.directions: Cross Navali's palm with silver to receive a prophecy.

currencies.name: Scrying Orb
currencies.description: [Scrying|Scries] a Map on your Atlas
currencies.directions: Right click on this item then left click a Map on your Atlas.

currencies.name: Bestiary Orb
currencies.description: Stores a Beast in an item
currencies.directions: Right click on this item then left click on a Beast in your Menagerie to itemise the Beast.

currencies.name: Empty Coffin
currencies.description: Stores a Corpse in an item
currencies.directions: Right click on this item then left click on a Corpse in the Necropolis Morgue.

currencies.name: Filled Coffin
currencies.directions: Right click on this item to use it while in the Necropolis to add it to the Necropolis Morgue.

currencies.description: Adds Elder influence and a new Elder modifier to a rare item

currencies.directions: Right click this item then left click a normal equipment item to apply it.

currencies.directions: Right click this item then left click an equipment item with Memory Strands to apply it.

currencies.directions: Right click this item then left click a Memory Influenced Map item to apply it. Can apply up to 3 to a single Map item.

currencies.directions: Right click on this item then left click on a Voidstone to apply the itemised Sextant Modifier to the Voidstone.

allflame.description:
Allflame crafting is a powerful tool that can be used to magnify the efficiency of your currency.

Place an item and a currency that is valid to apply that item into the crafting window. Assuming you can pay the cost of [DeadMansSulphur|Dead Man's Sulphur], you will be allowed to perform the craft which the placed currency would usually do to that item. However, instead of just one outcome you will instead create multiple [GhostlyCopy|Ghostly Copies], each of which is the result of having performed the crafting step on the original item. Allflame crafting cannot be performed on corrupted items, nor can it be used to corrupt things. Additionally, Allflame crafting does not work with most item quality applying or socket manipulating currency.

You can then choose one of these [GhostlyCopy|Ghostly Copies] to keep for yourself, effectively multiplying your currency use by the number of Copies created. Certain crafting steps will apply [Intangibility] however, which can limit the total Allflame crafting that can be done on a single item.
allflame.intangibilityDescription:
When Allflame crafting, many crafts will apply "Intangibility" to the resultant item, at a certain percentage. 

When then performing further Allflame crafts, there is a chance that Vesper will only be able to create one Ghostly Copy of the item, with that chance being equal to the Intangibility on the item being crafted upon.
allflame.ghostlyCopyDescription: Ghostly Copies of items that are not chosen will vanish. Items created as a result of Allflame Crafting cannot be returned to a previous state via Imprinting.
